$comment: Shared fixture for the persona-header matcher. Read by BOTH implementations:
The two languages cannot share code, so they share THIS FILE instead. Each
implementation has a self-check that runs every case below and asserts the
documented expectation, so the two matchers cannot drift apart silently.
Add a case here before changing either matcher.
$modes: strict  — the ONLY form accepted going forward. Used by the live workflow:
the approval gate and the turn router. A comment that does not
match strict has no recognized author and cannot open the merge
gate or satisfy a routing hand-off.
lenient — strict PLUS the historical drift eras below. Used ONLY for
backfilling attribution over comments that already exist
(scripts/generate-agent-graph.py). Never used to make a gate
